ctx.x: Yes, it's been released. Released a year ago -- called the Indestructible E. B. And I had me and Warren Vache and John Faddes. Panama Francis did some of
the sides, and Mosey Alexander did the other side. Milt Hinton and John Bunche -- and Bucky Pizzarelli did some of them.

items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I open at Michael's Pub on August 28th with Eddie Woodie Barefield.

ctx.x: Panama is finishing an engagement down here, and he's returning to New York to open at Michael's Pub. When are you going to Michael's Pub, Panama?
I open at Michael's Pub on August 28th with Eddie Woodie Barefield.

With Eddie Woodie Barefield, huh? Great. Well, man, I tell you -- it was a joy seeing your lovely place, and to see how great success has been for you down here all through this music business. Considering the troubles and what the music business is like, this is really a joy to see.
